cards.title: Play School Returns: Quality TV for Toddlers
cards.body: Parents can finally feel good about screen time with Play School's return, offering a refreshing alternative to frantic, attention-grabbing shows. The program provides the kind of quality content that doesn't make parents feel guilty about letting their toddler watch.

cards.title: Working Parents Need Better School Holiday Support
cards.body: School holidays create a logistical nightmare for working parents juggling childcare and work commitments. Better solutions are needed to help parents actually enjoy time with their kids without constant work distractions.

cards.title: Protecting Children From Parental Burnout Effects
cards.body: Parenting becomes significantly harder without adequate support or relief. Research shows parental burnout can have lasting effects on children's wellbeing.

cards.title: Parentification and Eating Disorders Connection
cards.body: Early role reversal in families—when children take on adult responsibilities—has long-term mental health effects. The link between parentification and eating disorders reveals how childhood dynamics shape adult health.

cards.title: Potty Training Scheme Expands to 20 Areas
cards.body: The government is rolling out a potty training initiative to help achieve development milestones. The scheme aims to ensure 75% of children end their first year of school with a good level of development by 2028.
